conflicts.sources_say: S04: 23 agents · S05 slides 13 & 15: 24 agents · S02 live: header '21 agents', footer '23 agents', 23 live cards
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Teach agent names, not a count. If a number is needed, quote '23 live agents (OS, 3 Nov 2026)'. Ask Gabriel to fix the OS header.

conflicts.sources_say: S04: 28 engagements and '30 yearly' · S05: 25 strategic clients/yr, 200 pitched → 30 run · S06: 50+ clients, 7 COEU engagements · S07: 35 engagements 2021-26 · S02: 28 engagements
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Do not show a total on learner material. Use the credential grid (named projects) only. Arnaud to set one canonical figure with date.

conflicts.sources_say: S05: NPS +53 across 82 sessions · S06: 87 sessions, NPS +53
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Use 'NPS +53 (Oct 2026, 87 sessions)' only on client material, marked as dated.

conflicts.sources_say: S05/S06: 8-12 weeks · S05 slide 19: 2 weeks to 8 months · S05 slide 3 phase durations Discover 3-4w, Define 2-3w, Co-Create 2-3w, T&D 2-12w
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Teach 'typical 8-12 weeks elapsed for a standard engagement; scope ranges from a single workshop to 8 months'.
Keep method placement (Define) as the teaching standard; note the OS grouping on the enabler card. Gabriel to align OS labels or document the difference.

conflicts.sources_say: S03: Define · S05 slide 15: listed under Discover · S02: Define (step 08)
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Define. S05 slide 15 to be corrected in its next version.

conflicts.sources_say: S03/S04: N0 Aware, N1 Contributor, N2 Facilitator, N3 Practitioner, N4 Lead/Faculty · S05 slide 40: 'contributor / creator / facilitator / practitioner' · S01 loose shape 'N3 : Facilitator'
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Use S03 labels everywhere. Retire 'creator'. Archive the V1 'N3 : Facilitator' shape.

conflicts.sources_say: S03: 05.04 Future Journey before 05.05 Participants · S01 V1 board: Participants column before Journey Map
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Keep S03 IDs and order in V2. Note on 05.05: groups are set up before the workshop day, as an input to 05.01, even though the block is taught after 05.04.

conflicts.sources_say: S03 splits 04.07 Preparation (Define) and 05.02 Facilitation (Co-create) · S01 labels both 'Ice breaker'
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Use full names with the split; preparation and facilitation are separate tasks.

conflicts.sources_say: S03: consumable in 10-15 min, 'six slides' in exercise · brief: 13-15 slides spec · S04: ≤10 pages for US Tech team
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Complementary constraints: 10-15 min reading time is the binding rule; test 6-15 light slides for readability.

conflicts.sources_say: S05 slide 28 presents 70% standard / 20% adapted / 10% innovation, with '70% … risk-free'
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Teach as a planning lens, not fixed proportions; standard solutions still need validation with users and operations.
Not used in learner material. Client-facing use needs Arnaud's sign-off and dated source.
